en.text: The best part is no part. The best process is no process.

zh.text: 最好的零件就是没有零件。最好的流程就是没有流程。

en.text: I think it's important to reason from first principles rather than by analogy.

zh.text: 我认为从第一性原理出发进行推理，而不是通过类比，是非常重要的。

en.text: Remove unnecessary parts. If a part is not needed, delete it.

zh.text: 删除不必要的零件。如果一个零件不需要，就删掉它。

en.text: First principles is a way of boiling things down to their fundamental truths and reasoning up from there.

zh.text: 第一性原理是一种将事物归结为基本真理，然后从那里向上推理的方法。

en.text: The key to making things affordable is design them to be manufacturable from the beginning.

zh.text: 使产品可负担的关键是从一开始就设计为可制造的。

en.text: I'm a strong believer in rapid iteration. Build it, test it, break it, fix it.

zh.text: 我坚信快速迭代。建造它，测试它，弄坏它，修复它。

en.text: A well-designed manufacturing process is more important than a well-designed product.

zh.text: 一个设计良好的制造过程比一个设计良好的产品更重要。

en.text: When something is important, you do it even if the odds are against you.

zh.text: 当某件事很重要时，即使胜算不大，你也要去做。

en.text: The most common error is not in the design, but in the assumptions behind the design.

zh.text: 最常见的错误不在于设计本身，而在于设计背后的假设。

en.text: You want to have a tight feedback loop between design and manufacturing.

zh.text: 你希望设计和制造之间有一个紧密的反馈循环。

en.text: The thing I learned at SpaceX is that you have to be willing to blow things up to learn.

zh.text: 我在SpaceX学到的是，你必须愿意炸毁东西来学习。

en.text: If you don't have a prototype, you don't have a product. Ideas are cheap, execution is everything.

zh.text: 如果你没有原型，你就没有产品。想法很廉价，执行才是一切。

en.text: Every single part in a rocket has to work perfectly. There's no room for error.

zh.text: 火箭中的每一个零件都必须完美工作。没有出错的余地。

en.text: The quality of the engineering team determines the quality of the product.

zh.text: 工程团队的质量决定了产品的质量。

en.text: I spend a lot of time on the factory floor. That's where the real engineering happens.

zh.text: 我花很多时间在工厂车间。真正的工程在那里发生。

en.text: Design is not just what it looks like. Design is how it works at scale.

zh.text: 设计不仅仅是外观。设计是它在规模化时如何运作。

en.text: The constraint drives the creativity. If you have unlimited resources, you don't innovate.

zh.text: 限制驱动创造力。如果你有无限的资源，你就不会创新。

en.text: We design for manufacturability first, then for performance. If you can't make it, it doesn't matter how good it is.

zh.text: 我们首先为可制造性设计，然后为性能设计。如果你不能制造它，它有多好都无关紧要。

en.text: The biggest breakthroughs come from questioning fundamental assumptions.

zh.text: 最大的突破来自于质疑基本假设。

en.text: I review every critical design myself. The CEO should be the chief engineer.

zh.text: 我自己审查每一个关键设计。CEO应该是首席工程师。

en.text: If you can't explain the engineering simply, you don't understand it well enough.

zh.text: 如果你不能简单地解释工程，说明你理解得不够好。

en.text: The most efficient manufacturing is when the product is so well designed that it almost builds itself.

zh.text: 最高效的制造是产品设计得如此之好，以至于它几乎能自己组装。

en.text: We use the same engineering principles across all our companies. First principles, rapid iteration, tight feedback loops.

zh.text: 我们在所有公司使用相同的工程原则。第一性原理、快速迭代、紧密反馈循环。

en.text: The key insight in engineering is that the simplest solution is usually the best one.

zh.text: 工程中的关键洞察是，最简单的解决方案通常是最好的。

en.text: You have to be willing to throw away your best idea if a better one comes along.

zh.text: 你必须愿意抛弃你最好的想法，如果有更好的想法出现。
